summary:
Apple Watch not lasting a full day, shutting down suddenly, or draining fast during workouts? Those are the classic signs of a worn battery.

If the screen is lifting off the case, the battery may be swollen. That's a safety issue, so stop wearing the watch and get it checked. We open the case safely, fit an OEM-grade cell, and reseal it properly, keeping your data intact.

Drop it off at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte, or book our R300 door-to-door collection anywhere in Gauteng. Outside Gauteng, we arrange courier collection nationwide.

The diagnostic is free, you get the price before we start, and every repair carries a 6-month warranty.

Tap Learn more for Apple Watch Battery Replacement prices and details.
